scripts.build: npm -w app run build && npm -w functions run build
scripts.check: tsc -p shared && tsc -p functions && npm -w app run check
scripts.test:emu: npm -w functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-mrx --only auth,database,functions "vitest run --project emulator"
scripts.emu: npm -w functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-mrx --only auth,database,functions
